base_style: High-contrast dark fantasy comic book illustration. Thick, chunky black ink work with heavy use of negative space and silhouettes. Flat color application with minimal gradients, reminiscent of Mike Mignola's art style or woodcut prints.
characters: Stylized, angular figures. Protagonists are rugged humans in medieval plate and chainmail armor. Monsters are depicted with jagged, hulking forms; specifically, obsidian-skinned giants covered in glowing yellow runes and orc-like creatures with tusks. Eyes are rendered as stark white or glowing pinpoints.
color_palette: Muted and desaturated earthy tones: olive greens, stone grays, and deep browns. High-contrast highlights include glowing amber, torch-fire yellow, and deep crimson accents against dominant, void-like blacks.
layout_and_composition: Vertical layout. A sequential series of five tall, narrow panels. Compositions emphasize a sense of scale and claustrophobia, utilizing low angles and dramatic foreground silhouettes to create depth.
lettering_and_dialog: Narrative-driven minimalist captions. Each panel is topped with a rectangular tan-colored header containing short, descriptive text.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: None. Captions: Tan rectangular boxes at the top center of panels with black serif typography. Voice Over: None. Chyrons: None. Sound Effects: None.
